up: Identify all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5303711. Return the ChEMBL ID of the document and the ChEMBL ID and preferred name of each associated compound.
sql:
SELECT
  d.chembl_id AS doc_chembl_id,
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5303711';
